inputs.original_text: It sounds like the familiar arrangement: illegal mining continues, a company that KTR says belongs to Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is implicated, and the Congress government is accused of looking away. That kind of inaction is hard to dismiss as ordinary oversight when powerful interests may benefit. The accusation may be only a fragment, but the rush to manage the story rather than confront the allegation is exactly what makes the whole setup look protected.

The accusation may be only a fragment, but the rush to manage the story instead of confronting it is what makes the whole setup look protected.
